title: Part Twenty-Nine: Templars, Mystics and the Stake

sections.brief: Templars 1119-1314: Hugh of Payns, Troyes 1129, Omne datum optimum 29 March 1139, deposits and letters of credit, Paris Temple as royal bank; arrests Friday 13 October 1307, charges, torture, Pastoralis praeeminentiae 22 Nov 1307; 54 burned 12 May 1310; Chinon 17-20 Aug 1308 (absolution, not innocence; Frale 2001/2004/2007; Baluze 1693); Vox in excelso 22 March 1312 (by provision), Ad providam 2 May 1312; Molay and Charney burned 18 March 1314; OTS errors corrected (Friday 13th origin, Chinon 'innocent', 3,000 arrested, 1.3m livres, Orsini at Chinon). Figures: compare (told vs record)

The kingdom within on trial: Beguines and Vienne's decree; Porete's annihilated soul, burned 1 June 1310; Eckhart's ground of the soul and birth of God in the soul, Cologne 1326, In agro dominico 27 March 1329; alumbrados' dejamiento, Manrique's 1525 edict (48 propositions), Ignatius 1527, Cazalla 1532; Luis de Leon; Molinos's prayer of quiet, arrest 1685, Coelestis Pastor 20 Nov 1687 (68 propositions); labelled interpretation (mediation thesis vs obedience reading). Figures: compare (teaching vs condemnation)

Bruno: arrest 1592, Roman trial, theological charges plus cosmology and magic, Sommario 1940, burned 17 Feb 1600, Index 1603, Yates thesis and critics, Sodano 2000; Galileo: 1616 consultants/Bellarmine/Index decree, 22 June 1633 abjuration and house arrest (not prison), 1758/1820/1835, John Paul II 1979-1992 and Coyne's critique; OTS 'burned for inner work/alchemy' corrected. Figures: time
